notes: The OpenedAt fence (f8994d21), read: record.ProductionCheck.ID() is OpenedAt.UnixMicro(), openCheck truncates its clock to the microsecond, NamedBy treats a zero OpenedAt as naming the current check (rows queued before the field; none exist in production since the feature is new); every CheckLook, CheckCompare and check start row enqueued in non-test code carries OpenedAt (grep: no site without it); the outbox reads the check before each row, finishes without acting when the row names a replaced check, and applies its fact under `check-look:<issue>:<ID>:<look>`, `check-look-hold:…`, `check-wake:<issue>:<ID>:<cause>:<build>` with the fact carrying the OpenedAt it read, which the engine re-checks (checkLookEnded, checkWake); the API's report under `check:<issue>:<ID>:<looks>:<verdict>`. The report fact carries no OpenedAt: the route reads the check and applies in one request, so only a merge of the same issue between the two (microseconds, serialised by the fact lock) could misroute it — accepted.
